column3: Enough. You let the Stars\nfall into their hands. And\nnow you expect my trust?{end_wait}
Mia, Jenna and Kraden are\nhis hostages. We need to\nfight with you, not against{page_break}you.{end_wait}
You couldn't protect Sol\nSanctum. Why should I trust\nyou with this lighthouse?{end_wait}
I'm asking you to move. I\nwon't stand aside while\nJenna's up there.{end_wait}
Then show me you can\nstand your ground, Isaac.{page_break}Face me alone.{end_wait}
Settle it, then. I can\nwait, and it'll show me\nwhat you're made of.{end_wait}
Tch... You're stronger than\na fool has any right to be.{end_wait}
That's enough. He held\nback, and I could feel it\nin every blow.{end_wait}
We're not your enemy, Mia.\nWe want Jenna and the Stars\nback just like you do.{end_wait}
...Then I'll trust you, a\nlittle. Keep Saturos busy\nwhile I go after Menardi.{end_wait}
Keep him busy, fools. I'll\nbring the captives back\nmyself.{end_wait}
The healer has gone ahead.\nNow it's your turn, Adepts.{end_wait}
